parameters.query:
with cases(trace_id,subject,invoice_reference) as (
  values
    ('gate5-positive','gate5-pe10-authorized-v1','__CASE003_GATE5_INVOICE_REFERENCE__'),
    ('gate5-wrong-vendor','gate5-other-vendor-v1','__CASE003_GATE5_INVOICE_REFERENCE__'),
    ('gate5-no-permission','gate5-no-permission-v1','__CASE003_GATE5_INVOICE_REFERENCE__'),
    ('gate5-unknown','gate5-unknown-user-v1','__CASE003_GATE5_INVOICE_REFERENCE__')
)
select q.*
from cases c
cross join lateral case003.supplier_invoice_query_direct(
  '__CASE003_GATE5_TENANT_ID__'::uuid,
  'test',
  c.subject,
  c.invoice_reference,
  c.trace_id
) q
order by c.trace_id;
